application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1 Crab Apple (x1) Reduce crown by 1m all around and thin crown by 25%. Final height 3.5m and width 4.5m. Reason: To contain the height and spread of the tree. Close to building.
T2 Bay tree (x1) Reduce height by 2m (back to previous points of reduction). Final height 3m and width 2m. Reason: To maintain the tree at a smaller size.
T4 Apple (x1) Reduce crown by 1.5m (back to previous points of reduction).Final height 3.5m and width 5m. Reason: To maintain the tree at a smaller size.
T5 Cedar (x1) Reduce the upper crown on the side over the lawn back by 1.5m and blend in with rest of crown. Final height 19m and width16m. Reason: To contain the height and spread of the tree in context to the garden size.
T6 Bay tree (x1) Reduce height by 2m all round. Final height 7m and width 5m.Reason: To contain the height and spread of the tree in context to the garden size.
